# Clark Digital Commons

> > Clark Digital Commons is Clark University's institutional repository for preserving and sharing scholarly research, student works, archives, and creative output.

Clark Digital Commons serves as the central hub for Clark University's knowledge and research ecosystem, built on the bepress Digital Commons platform. The repository encompasses faculty research, student works, university archives, special collections including the Goddard Collection, and multimedia content documenting Clark's engagement with Worcester and beyond.

## Main Collections

- [Faculty Works](https://commons.clarku.edu/faculty_works): Repository of faculty research and scholarly works at Clark University
- [Student Works](https://commons.clarku.edu/student_works): Student research, theses, literary magazines, and undergraduate works collection
- [Archives & Special Collections](https://commons.clarku.edu/archives): University archives and special collections including Goddard Collection
- [Clark in Worcester](https://commons.clarku.edu/clarkinworcester): Clark University's engagement and legacy in Worcester, Massachusetts collection
- [Video Archive](https://commons.clarku.edu/videoarchive): Streaming audio and video archive of Clark University lectures and events

## Browse & Discover

- [Communities](https://commons.clarku.edu/communities.html): Browse research collections and communities including Goddard, Davis, and Atwood collections
- [Browse by Discipline](https://commons.clarku.edu/do/discipline_browser/disciplines): Browse repository content by academic discipline and research field
- [Browse by Author](https://commons.clarku.edu/authors.html): Alphabetical author directory and browse functionality for Clark Digital Commons
- [Most Popular Papers](https://commons.clarku.edu/topdownloads.html): Most downloaded and popular research papers from Clark Digital Commons
- [Recent Additions](https://commons.clarku.edu/recent_additions.html): Recently added content to Clark Digital Commons repository

## Information & Guidelines

- [About Institutional Repositories](https://commons.clarku.edu/about.html): Information about Clark Digital Commons institutional repository and Goddard Library
- [Policies and Submission Guidelines](https://commons.clarku.edu/guidelines.html): Content submission guidelines, copyright policies, and deposit requirements
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://commons.clarku.edu/faq.html): FAQ covering submission, metadata, file formats, and copyright policies
- [Terms of Use](https://commons.clarku.edu/terms_of_use.html): Terms of use, copyright, and Creative Commons licensing information

## User Tools & Support

- [User Account Login](https://commons.clarku.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User login and account management for Clark Digital Commons
- [Email Notifications and RSS](https://commons.clarku.edu/announcements.html): Email alerts and RSS feed subscriptions for Clark Digital Commons updates

## Repository Statistics

- [Activity by Year](https://commons.clarku.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and annual activity metrics for Clark Digital Commons
